rows.text: The water cycle is how water moves around the Earth. It starts when water from oceans, lakes, and rivers turns into water vapor and rises into the air. This is called evaporation. The water vapor cools and turns back into liquid, forming clouds through condensation. When the clouds get heavy, the water falls back to the ground as precipitation, like rain or snow. Then, the water collects in bodies of water again, and the cycle starts over. This process keeps Earth's water moving and available for living things.

rows.text: Vaccines work by teaching your immune system how to recognize and fight off specific germs, like viruses or bacteria. They contain a small, harmless piece of the germ, such as a protein or sugar, or a weakened or dead version of the germ itself. When you get a vaccine, your body sees this piece as a threat and starts making antibodies to fight it. These antibodies stay in your body, so if you're ever exposed to the real germ, your immune system can quickly recognize and destroy it, preventing you from getting sick.

Bring layers in case the temperature changes. If you're camping, add a tent, sleeping bag, and cooking supplies. Don't forget sunscreen, insect repellent, and a flashlight. Check the weather forecast before you go. It's also a good idea to let someone know your hiking plans and expected return time. Enjoy your hike!

rows.text: A good habit for better sleep is to establish a consistent bedtime routine. This helps signal to your body that it's time to wind down, making it easier to fall asleep and improve sleep quality. Try activities like reading a book, taking a warm bath, or practicing gentle stretches before bed. Avoid screens and stimulating activities close to bedtime, as they can interfere with your body's natural sleep-wake cycle. Creating a calm and dark sleep environment also supports restful sleep. Consistency in your routine helps regulate your internal clock, leading to more restful and restorative sleep over time.

rows.text: The tallest mountain in Africa is Mount Kilimanjaro. It is located in Tanzania, near the border with Kenya. Mount Kilimanjaro is a free-standing mountain, meaning it is not part of a mountain range. It has three distinct volcanic cones: Kibo, Mawenzi, and Shira. Kibo is the highest, with its summit, Uhuru Peak, reaching an elevation of about five thousand eight hundred and ninety five meters, or just over three thousand five hundred and forty five thousand feet. The mountain is a popular destination for hikers and climbers. It is also a significant landmark in the region.

rows.text: Copper is used in electrical wiring because it conducts electricity very well. It is also used in plumbing for pipes because it is durable and resistant to corrosion. Copper's excellent conductivity makes it efficient for transmitting electrical signals with minimal loss. Its resistance to rust and long lifespan in plumbing ensure reliable water transport and prevent leaks. These properties make copper a preferred material in both electrical and plumbing applications.
